facts.fact: The Information Regulator's annual report for the year ended 31 March 2025 states it is an independent body established under section 39 of POPIA, with a chairperson and members who held 4 ordinary and 40 special meetings in 2024/25.
facts.system: Protection of Personal Information Act 4 of 2013 (POPIA)

facts.fact: The Information Regulator reports that it monitored and enforced POPIA in 2024/25, issuing POPIA enforcement notices and assessing responsible parties under section 89, which presupposes the Act in force; dated to the end of the reporting year.
facts.system: Protection of Personal Information Act 4 of 2013 (POPIA)

facts.fact: The Information Regulator reports that in 2024/25 it received 1355 POPIA complaints, up 30 percent on the year before, and that 745 of them were resolved.
facts.system: Protection of Personal Information Act 4 of 2013 (POPIA)

facts.fact: The Information Regulator reports for 2024/25 that 66 percent (210 of 320) of POPIA complex complaints and 90 percent (480 of 535) of simple complaints were completed within the prescribed timeframes.
facts.system: Protection of Personal Information Act 4 of 2013 (POPIA)

facts.fact: The Information Regulator reports that five POPIA enforcement notices were issued in 2024/25, against Blouberg Local Municipality, WhatsApp LLC, the Independent Electoral Commission, Lancet Laboratories and the Department of Basic Education, and three infringement notices carrying fines of R200 000, R100 000 and R5 million.
facts.system: Protection of Personal Information Act 4 of 2013 (POPIA)

facts.fact: The Information Regulator issued a POPIA enforcement notice to WhatsApp LLC on 10 September 2024 after an assessment under section 89, finding its privacy policy in breach of POPIA; WhatsApp then took the Regulator to judicial review.
facts.system: Protection of Personal Information Act 4 of 2013 (POPIA)

facts.fact: The Information Regulator issued a POPIA enforcement notice to the Independent Electoral Commission of South Africa on 10 September 2024, and later an infringement notice carrying a R100 000 administrative fine for failure to comply; the report gives no date for the infringement notice.
facts.system: Protection of Personal Information Act 4 of 2013 (POPIA)

facts.fact: The Information Regulator issued a POPIA enforcement notice to Drs Mauff AC & Partners t/a Lancet Laboratories on 10 September 2024.
facts.system: Protection of Personal Information Act 4 of 2013 (POPIA)

facts.fact: The Information Regulator issued a POPIA enforcement notice to the Department of Basic Education on 18 November 2024, followed by an infringement notice for non-compliance carrying an administrative fine of R5 million (undated in the report); the Department has brought appeal or review applications.
facts.system: Protection of Personal Information Act 4 of 2013 (POPIA)

facts.fact: The Information Regulator finalised a POPIA enforcement notice in Mabore v Blouberg Local Municipality on 8 August 2024, after referral by the Enforcement Committee on 4 June 2024.
facts.system: Protection of Personal Information Act 4 of 2013 (POPIA)

facts.fact: The Information Regulator reports that in 2024/25 twelve responsible parties were assessed on compliance with POPIA against a target of ten, and 17 POPIA education programmes were run, training 1177 participants.
facts.system: Protection of Personal Information Act 4 of 2013 (POPIA)

facts.fact: The Information Regulator published its Guidance Note on Direct Marketing under POPIA in December 2024.
facts.system: Protection of Personal Information Act 4 of 2013 (POPIA)
